goal: Apply only the three minimal fixes from Codex R2 Cycle 7.
findings: Precisely bind accept and waive terminal replay actions to aggregate, command and receipt
Coordinate independent contenders at the actual stale CAS update boundary
Compare tenant-wide deliverable link/action snapshots in accept zero-residue tests

implemented.R2F7-1: Accept/waive replay now requires the exact legal action lifecycle and binds the terminal action actor/time/reason to the authoritative aggregate, replay principal, receipt original createdAtUtc and normalized command payload. Waive without submit is exactly initialized+waived; waive after submit is exactly initialized+submitted+waived; accept is exactly initialized+submitted+accepted. Memory/SQLite regressions cover coordinated terminal-action+receipt tamper and initialized-action deletion.
implemented.R2F7-2: The CAS regression now runs two independent child-process product handlers. Test-layer-only SQLite method instrumentation lets both actual handler write transactions read v1 and blocks immediately before each real CAS UPDATE. The parent releases only after both update-boundary markers report v1. The loser executes the stale WHERE version=1 update after winner commit and surfaces only DELIVERABLE_VERSION_CONFLICT; six durable fact categories remain unique. No production hook, permission or bypass was added.
implemented.R2F7-3: The no-residue snapshot helper now captures every deliverable evidence link and action for the tenant, plus tenant-wide events, outbox and receipts. Memory reads its actual snapshot; SQLite uses one independent read-only connection. Requirement ID is never used as a filter, and pre/post sets are complete deepEqual values.
